fact: Car 11 unnecessarily impeding Car 16 in turn 3.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 11 (Sergio Perez), the driver of Car 16 (Charles Leclerc), team representatives and reviewed video with them. All parties agreed, in light of it being free practice, that the incident did not warrant a penalty.
rules_referenced: Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 11 Alleged Impeding Of Car 16
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
